rules.accepted_credit_types: Providers recognized by ACPE or the California Pharmacists Association (CPhA); pharmacy-relevant courses approved by the Medical Board, Board of Podiatric Medicine, Dental Board or Board of Registered Nursing of California; Board-provided courses; individual petitions
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal of a pharmacist license.
rules.carryover: Not allowed; CE must be completed during the two years preceding the renewal application.
rules.audit_note: Random Board audits; keep certificates 4 years. The Board has no access to NABP CPE Monitor, and Board-provided webinars do not appear there.

topics.who: Board-provided law webinar (1 h) and ethics webinar (1 h)
Course on LGBTQ patients, BIPOC health disparities and intersectionality (B&P §4231(a))
Pharmacists who prescribe Schedule II drugs: Board-approved course on addiction risks

rules.notes: Renewing pharmacists enter the number of CE hours on the renewal form. Advanced Pharmacist Practitioners need 10 more hours (40 total). Since Jan 1, 2026 (AB 1503) furnishing/vaccination functions no longer need specialized CE.
rules.legal_basis: Business and Professions Code sections 4231 through 4234; California Code of Regulations sections 1732 through 1732.7
